AboutDialog.Text_PrivacyText: CueLine 仅在播放时使用麦克风和系统语音识别。应用不会保存录音。
AboutDialog.Text_PrivacyBody:
CueLine is a local teleprompter. Scripts you type or open are stored on this device.

Microphone access is used only while you tap Play, so the app can follow the words you speak and scroll the script. When you stop playback or leave the teleprompter, listening stops.

Speech recognition is provided by the operating system (for example Google speech services on Android, or Apple speech recognition on iOS). CueLine does not send audio to its own servers. The system recognizer may use a network connection when an offline language pack is not installed.

CueLine does not create user accounts and does not include advertising or analytics SDKs of its own.
